facts.fact: UNCTAD's peer-review overview says CEMAC Regulation No. 04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC of 21 December 2018 on payment services, directly applicable in Gabon, protects consumers' funds, which may be used only for payment operations and are shielded from other creditors.

UNCTAD's peer-review overview says CEMAC Regulation No. 01/20/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC of 3 July 2020 on banking products and services, directly applicable in Gabon, requires banks to publish conditions, bans misleading advertising and organises amicable handling of consumer complaints.
facts.system: CEMAC Regulation 01/20 on banking products and services

facts.fact: UNCTAD's peer-review overview says a 2022 draft consumer protection law, covering financial and banking services and electronic communication services, is pending, Gabon having no specific consumer protection law and the 2019 CEMAC directive not yet transposed.
